text: いしころ　あてると　にげる　かも　しれないが　つかまえ　やすくは　なるよ！

structure.jp: いしころ　あてると
structure.en: if you hit one with a Rock

structure.jp: にげる　かも　しれないが
つかまえ　やすくは　なるよ！
structure.en: it does get easier to catch!

patterns.name: 〜かもしれない
patterns.span: にげる　かも　しれない
patterns.explanation: かもしれない after a verb means 'might', for something that is possible but not sure. にげる かも しれない = 'it might run away'.

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい added to a verb means 'easy to do'. With は なる after it, the meaning is 'it does at least become easy'. つかまえ やすくは なる = 'it does get easier to catch'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'when' or 'if' this happens, the next thing follows. あてると = 'if you hit it'.
